top: An influencer stopped a couple in a Long Island supermarket and offered $500 or a 5-minute shopping spree. Then he learned she has stage 4 breast cancer. Two weeks later, they got a free wedding at Top of the Rock.
comment: He only wanted to give away groceries. A nonprofit and dozens of local businesses did the rest.

title: She thought it was just a grocery run #wedding #heartwarming #kindness
description:
